query: INSERT INTO twitch_engagement_sender_auth (twitch_user_id, twitch_login, access_token_enc, refresh_token_enc, scopes, token_expires_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, now()) ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id) DO UPDATE SET twitch_login      = EXCLUDED.twitch_login, access_token_enc  = EXCLUDED.access_token_enc, refresh_token_enc = EXCLUDED.refresh_token_enc, scopes            = EXCLUDED.scopes, token_expires_at  = EXCLUDED.token_expires_at, updated_at        = now()
